title: EventEnvelope
description: NovaFabric Event Envelope v1 — canonical wire format for all evidence events.

envelope_version.description: Always the string '1'. String type allows forward parsers to distinguish unknown future versions.

schema_version.description: Compound schema identifier. Must be 'event-envelope/1' for this version.

event_id.description: Globally unique ULID for this event. Content-addressable storage key.

global_run_id.description: Logical distributed run identifier. Identical across all events in the same distributed run.

run_id.description: Per-process capsule identifier. Equals global_run_id for PARENT/STANDALONE capsules.

parent_run_id.description: null for STANDALONE/PARENT capsules; non-null for WORKER/COORDINATOR capsules.

event_type.description: Event kind. Indexed by the metadata database. The original six lowercase/dotted values (run.start, run.end, model_call, tool_call, span, capsule.finalize) were never actually emitted by any real producer in this repository (ADR-0220) and are retained only for schema backward-compatibility. Real run-boundary producers (src/novafabric/capture/orchestrator.py) emit the four RunStarted/RunCompleted/RunFailed/RunAborted values, matching schemas/event_schema.py::CapsuleEventType 1:1, so LineageConsumer/KGIngestionPipeline (which already expect the canonical taxonomy) extract real edges from cluster-scale NATS traffic (ADR-0220 Option A).

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context 16-byte trace ID as 32 lowercase hex chars. Must not be all-zeros.

span_id.description: W3C Trace Context 8-byte span ID as 16 lowercase hex chars. Must not be all-zeros.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the emitting agent or SDK component.

cluster_id.description: Cluster identifier. null in local/single-machine mode.

tenant_id.description: Multi-tenancy identifier. null in single-tenant/local mode.

started_at.description: Event start time. ISO 8601 with timezone offset, millisecond precision. Best-effort; do not use for strict ordering.

emitter_node_id.description: Hostname or node identifier. null when unavailable.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Schema is defined per event_type, not here. Unknown keys must be tolerated.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the serialized payload bytes, in 'sha256:<hex>' form.

nova.batch.signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 detached signature, attached by the NovaSeal Batch Processor.

nova.batch.signing_key_id.description: UUID identifying the NovaSeal signing key.

UuidV7.description: UUID v7 (RFC 9562) as a 36-character hyphenated lowercase string.

RunId.description: Run identifier: either a 26-char ULID or a 36-char UUID v7.
